name: CMake file(DOWNLOAD) without hash verification or with TLS verification disabled
attack_scenario: a compromised release host or on-path attacker serves a malicious archive for an unpinned download; CMake extracts and builds it into the project, running attacker-controlled code on every build machine that configures the project
negative_test_hint: point the download at "https://evil.example.com/dep.tar.gz" without EXPECTED_HASH and assert the configure step is rejected instead of fetching and building the archive

exemplar.explanation: file(DOWNLOAD ...) without EXPECTED_HASH accepts whatever bytes the server (or a MITM) returns, and CMAKE_TLS_VERIFY OFF / TLS_VERIFY OFF disables certificate checking outright. CMake recommends always pinning EXPECTED_HASH so a tampered or corrupted download is rejected before it is built.
